categories.main_business_segments: Kureha Corporation operates five main business segments: Functional Products (including functional resins, carbon products), Chemical Products (agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, inorganic and organic chemicals), Resin Products (food packaging materials, household goods), Construction-related Business (civil engineering and construction), and Other Related Businesses (logistics, environmental services, real estate, and healthcare). The core focus is on the manufacturing and sales of functional, chemical, and resin products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Kureha's core technologies include advanced polymer synthesis (notably PVDF and PPS resins), carbon material processing, and specialty chemical synthesis. The company emphasizes proprietary process development for high-performance polymers (e.g., PVDF for lithium-ion battery binders, PGA for oil/gas applications), as well as continuous improvement in productivity, cost reduction, and environmental impact mitigation through process innovation and digitalization (DX).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the automotive (especially EVs), electronics, energy (oil/gas drilling), agriculture (agrochemicals), healthcare (pharmaceuticals), and food packaging industries. End markets are diverse, with a strategic focus on environment/energy, life (healthcare, agriculture), and information/communications sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Kureha operates globally, with major operations in Japan, Asia (notably China and Vietnam), North America (primarily the US), and Europe. Sales are well-diversified, with Japan accounting for the largest share, followed by Asia, Europe, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kureha is primarily positioned as an upstream and midstream supplier, providing specialty materials, chemicals, and intermediate products to downstream manufacturers in various industries. It also engages in some downstream activities through consumer goods (household wraps) and environmental services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening R&D and technical capabilities, accelerating differentiated product development, and expanding into growth areas such as EV battery materials, sustainable agriculture, and advanced composites. The company is investing in digital transformation (DX), carbon neutrality initiatives, and global production capacity, with a focus on innovation, sustainability, and value chain integration.
categories.revenue_model: Kureha generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured products (functional resins, chemicals, packaging materials, consumer goods), contract construction services, and environmental/real estate services. Revenue is recognized mainly at the point of product delivery or service completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global specialty chemical and advanced materials companies such as Solvay, Arkema, Daikin, and domestic peers like Toray and Asahi Kasei. Kureha positions itself as a specialty player with unique, high-value-added products, focusing on niche markets where it can leverage proprietary technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, consolidated revenue was ¥162.0 billion, with operating profit of ¥9.4 billion and net profit attributable to owners of ¥7.8 billion. The company has experienced a recent revenue and profit decline due to market headwinds in EVs and oil/gas, but expects a recovery as new investments and market diversification bear fruit. Total assets are ¥345.3 billion, with around 4,000 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kureha emphasizes its ability to deliver highly differentiated, specialty materials based on proprietary technology, offering superior performance, reliability, and sustainability. Its value proposition centers on solving customer and societal challenges in energy, environment, and life sciences, with a strong focus on innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility.
